(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A method for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising: accessing a resource locator associated with a second server computer through a computer network; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers to the locator, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: A system for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a second server computer that is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; and circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a computer readable medium containing program instructions that, when executed by a processor, perform the steps of: providing a second server computer that is a Web application server, the server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; selecting the hyperlink by the client computer; and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.
